annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2004/104/EC adapting to technical progress Council Directive 72/245/EEC relating to the radio interference (electromagnetic compatibility) of vehicles and amending Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2004/104/EC adapting to technical progress Council Directive 72/245/EEC relating to the radio interference (electromagnetic compatibility) of vehicles and amending Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union L 337/13
annotation.summary_en: 2004 Commission Directive updating EU electromagnetic compatibility type-approval requirements for motor vehicles and electrical/electronic subassemblies, with emission and immunity limits, test methods, marking and conformity-of-production rules. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces annexes of Directive 72/245/EEC with updated EMC requirements
Sets radiated emission limits and immunity test levels for vehicles and ESAs
Aftermarket non-safety components need only a Declaration of Conformity
Phased application dates from 2006 to 2009 for type-approval and registration
Member States must transpose by 31 December 2005
